definitions.explanation: internet slang derived from {笑|わら}った (waratta, 'I laughed'); originated from 2channel/online bulletin boards; equivalent to English 'LOL'

examples.japanese: この{動画|どうが}わろた
examples.english: This video made me laugh / LOL at this video

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}の{返信|へんしん}が{面白|おもしろ}すぎてわろた
examples.english: My friend's reply was so funny I LOL'd.

notes:
INTERNET SLANG:
わろた originated on Japanese internet forums (2channel) in the 2000s. It's a playful corruption of {笑|わら}った (waratta, 'I laughed').

VARIATIONS:
- わろた (standard)
- ワロタ (katakana)
- ワロス / わろす (older variation)
- {草|くさ} - newer equivalent meaning 'LOL' (from www looking like grass)

USAGE:
Primarily used in online text communication (social media, messaging, forums). Expresses amusement in a casual, somewhat ironic way.

REGISTER:
Very casual internet slang. Not used in formal writing or professional contexts.
